globalRules.rule: All 18 fields preserve specification order (base 13 plus 5 Fleet Tags in Auth Completion messages).
Empty non-trailing fields retain their separators.
Unneeded trailing optional fields may be omitted when permitted.
Fields 14-18 (Fleet Tag 1-5) are only sent in Auth Completion (0220) messages and only when Host Prompts are supported.
Merchants must not send Segment 101 and Segment 145 (Enhanced Fleet) in the same message.
Segment 101 is included in all fleet-card financial transaction requests (companion to Segment 100).
Segment 101 appears in Data Section No. 3 (see Section 11.1.1).

Base Segment 101 maximum length is 61 alphanumeric characters (Element 84 range 001-061). The maximum with Fleet Tags in Auth Completion messages exceeds 61 by construction; the spec inconsistency is REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Conditional fields are evaluated from transaction, card, channel, lifecycle, companion, and fleet-program context.
Fleet card processing requirements are governed by BUYPASS Petroleum Industry Processing Specifications (Section 10.6); ATL105 defines only the wire-format segment layout.

openQuestions.question: Are the base segment max length (61) and Fleet Tags (5 x 34 = 170) reconcilable inside a single serialized Segment 101, or is Auth Completion carrying Fleet Tags governed by a different segment-length rule?
Does the DLN fleet tag code carry the driver license name or a different attribute? Section 12.2 text reads 'Driver License nameation' which appears to be an OCR/spec typo.
For each Conditional field, which fleet-program rule (Petroleum Industry Processing Specifications) mandates its presence? ATL105 does not enumerate the trigger conditions.

Is Segment 101 permitted in Financial Response messages, or is it request-only? Section 11 index references appear only in Request. The training scope treats it as request+completion until an authoritative response-side reference is located.
